messages:
sam.g: CI keeps failing on master (3/3) with an intermittent unit failure in streamAlignerOrderingTest. It passes locally for me 9/10 runs but fails in CI with this assertion. Can someone kick a rerun and/or bisect?

ci-bot: Jenkins job: https://ci.internal.redwood/teams/eng-runtime/job/PR-4123/57 — failed tests: streamAlignerOrderingTest (run 57). Logs archived. :warning:

maya: I saw a similar flake last week but it had a different stack. Quick questions: was the job using the shared test-executor pool? if so, test isolation might be leaking. Can we get the failing commit id from the job? Also pinging @dillon for bisect help.

dillon: I can bisect. Sam, can you paste the failing assertion and the minimal repro command? If we can reproduce locally we can add a deterministic seed to the test and bisect the commit that regressed.

sam.g: Repro snippet from the CI node (sanitized):
```
java -jar target/test-runner.jar --tests StreamAlignerOrderingTest --seed=0x4f3a --executor-pool-size=8
AssertionError: expected order [A,B,C] but got [A,C,B]
 at com.redwood.runtime.stream.StreamAlignerTest.assertOrder(StreamAlignerTest.java:132)
 at com.redwood.runtime.stream.StreamAlignerTest.testOrdering(StreamAlignerTest.java:78)
```
This only fails when executor-pool-size >= 6 and the CI node is under load. Locally: `./gradlew :runtime:test --tests "*StreamAlignerOrderingTest" -Dtest.seed=0x4f3a` reproduces ~30% of runs for me.

maya: Good repro. Two quick triage steps: (1) rerun the Jenkins job with isolated pool (set EXECUTOR_POOL=2) to see if it goes green, (2) add a temporary `@Flaky` marker and a minimal logging patch to dump timer/event ordering when it fails so we can capture the sequence. If it disappears with pool=2 that's a strong scheduling nondeterminism signal.

dillon: I'll start a bisect tomorrow morning. Sam, can you open a reproduce/diagnostic branch and push the failing run output (logs + seed) to it? Name it `diag/stream-aligner-flake`. I'll add a bisect script; plan: binary search with the seed pinned and `--executor-pool-size=8`.

oncall-bot: NOTE: This test is currently blocking the 1.8.0 release branch. Please triage asap. Assigned priority: high.

sam.g: Branch created, pushed logs and the failing job link: https://git.internal.redwood/redwood/runtime/compare/diag/stream-aligner-flake. I also added a tiny log statement around the aligner timer. If anyone has cycles, please review so I can submit the PR (small change). Otherwise I'll queue the bisect run after I get +1.

dillon: Got it. I will queue an automated bisect using your branch artifacts and post results here. If it looks like a scheduler race we can try a short-term mitigation: clamp executor pool size in CI for this test or add a retry in the test harness while we root-cause. :thumbsup:
